invariants.rationale: Method always returns a non-null List<V> as per the chain of Java Stream collect operations.
Result is constructed using collect(Collectors.toList()), ensuring it is a List.
Each input element can contribute to at most one key in the result; therefore, the result cannot be larger than the input size.
Parallelism parameter must be greater than 0 to execute in parallel, as is standard in concurrent stream APIs.
The method operates on 'data' and streams from it, so data must be non-null at this point.
